title: Print shop job board
brief:
Complete the following real project in the current, initially empty directory. Choose the deliverables, media, tools, structure and implementation that serve the intended user. Build usable artifacts and check your work. Deliver the project itself. Omit personally identifying credits, author signatures and model or toolchain identity labels. No network access or credentials are provided.

Build an offline job board for a two-person copy shop. Orders move through Intake, Proofing, Ready to Print, Printing, and Pickup. Seed a 75-copy recital program due Tuesday at 15:00 awaiting proof, a 200-copy museum flyer due Wednesday at 10:00 ready to print, and a 30-copy class booklet due Tuesday at noon ready for pickup. Let staff set actual due dates and times, move jobs forward or back, record partial pickups, and see outstanding quantities. Highlight overdue jobs that still have copies to hand over. Include a printable daily queue grouped by what staff can act on.

files.body:
FOLIO COPY SHOP
Open index.html in a browser with local storage enabled. No installation or internet connection is needed.

Use the same browser profile and file location on the shop computer for both staff members. Orders are saved in that browser. Clearing its site data removes saved orders.

On first use, the board assigns the sample orders to the next Tuesday (today if it is Tuesday) and the following Wednesday. Click any job to set its actual deadline or change its stage in either direction. Use New job for incoming orders.

At Pickup, enter only the number collected on this visit and save. The board subtracts that amount from the outstanding count. Fully collected orders leave the active board and queue.

Print daily queue prints the current outstanding workload grouped by the next shop action. Each group lists the earliest due job first, including overdue work and upcoming jobs staff can begin today.

files.name: README.md
files.body:
# Copy Desk

Open **index.html** in a regular browser window on the shop computer. Keep all three app files together. The board works offline and saves orders in that browser profile. Both staff should use the same profile and open the same file. Keep the file in a fixed location and retain the browser’s site data to preserve the board. Orders do not sync between computers or browser profiles.

## At the counter

- Select **New job** and enter the order quantity, stage, and local due date and time. Select a job’s name to edit its details.
- Use the forward action or the back arrow to move between Intake, Proofing, Ready to Print, Printing, and Pickup.
- In **Pickup**, select **Record pickup** and enter the number of copies handed over. The remaining count updates immediately. Select the job name to see pickup history. Fully collected orders move to the **Completed** filter.
- A job becomes **Overdue** after its due time while it still has outstanding copies. Use the filter to find overdue jobs or jobs due today.
- Open **Daily queue** to see all open work grouped by the next staff action, with the earliest deadlines first in each group. **Print queue** opens the browser’s print dialog for that same list, regardless of the current board filter.

The initial orders are dated Tuesday and Wednesday of the shop computer’s current week on first open. Change their dates from the job cards.
